subject: Arcadia: Assessment corpus exchange & MAP — next steps
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Robinson <maya@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, Sep 4, 2025 at 9:12 AM -0700
Subject: Arcadia: Assessment corpus exchange & MAP — next steps

Hi Maya —

Great meeting yesterday. Per our discussion I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a small sample of the assessment corpus and a prompt pack so your ML team can sanity-check mechanics before we transfer the full set. High-level ask: we want a narrow, time-limited evaluation license (no training), clear retention limits, and an audit trail for usage.

Proposed MAP highlights (high level):
- Week 0 (today): share sample CSV + prompt pack (attached) for technical validation.
- Week 1: Arcadia feedback on sample; security questionnaire notes.
- Week 2: sign MAP and exchange full dataset under sealed SFTP/Drive link.
- Week 6: final evaluation readout and close (aimed to align with procurement).

Usage guardrails included in the MAP draft:
- Evaluation-only, no model training or derivative dataset distribution.
- Delete raw copies after 60 days post-evaluation unless otherwise agreed.
- PII scrubbed by Arcadia prior to export; Redwood will not request raw PHI.
- Attribution and internal-use limits spelled out in section 3.

Attachments: Arcadia_MAP_v1.docx, Arcadia_AssessmentDataset_sample-20250918.csv, Arcadia_PromptPack_v1.zip

Next actions:
1) Can you confirm who on your side will accept DocuSign (legal/procurement)?
2) Any additional non-negotiable clauses we should surface before we send to legal?

Thanks — I can hop on a 20m call if you want to walk the MAP.

—
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: Arcadia_AssessmentDataset_sample-20250918.csv (1.2 MB)]

From: Maya Robinson <maya@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@arcadiahealth.com>, procurement@arcadiahealth.com
Date: Mon, Sep 8, 2025 at 10:03 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Arcadia: Assessment corpus exchange & MAP — next steps

Thanks Jasmine — this is helpful. Quick answers up front: Liam will be our technical lead, procurement will handle signatures once legal signs off. A couple of notes from our side after reviewing the draft MAP and sample: 

- Sample looks representative. Our engineers want an additional metadata column (data_source_id) so lineage is preserved.
- Security: we will complete the attached security questionnaire by EOW. We have a standard clause: any data that contains PHI must never leave our VPC. The sample looks de-identified but we need a statement in the MAP that Redwood will not request or require raw PHI.
- Licensing: we are okay with evaluation-only, but procurement will propose a 90-day retention window (instead of 60).

Also attaching our standard Data Access Addendum (DAA) and security questionnaire for your review. Can Vivek or Marcus take a look at the DAA redlines?

Let us know if we should set up a short legal-to-legal sync.

Best,
Maya
Head of ML Platforms, Arcadia Health
maya@arcadiahealth.com | +1 212-555-8765

[Attachment: Arcadia_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (120 KB)]
[Attachment: Arcadia_DAA_standard.docx (15 KB)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, Sep 9, 2025 at 08:20 AM -0700
Subject: Fwd: Arcadia: Assessment corpus exchange & MAP — DAA review

FYI — forwarding Maya's note and attachments. Quick read: procurement's 90-day retention is reasonable commercially; we should push back on training prohibition being explicit and non-ambiguous. Suggested redlines for DAA:

- Explicit clause: "Assessment Data" means data provided by Arcadia solely for the purpose of model assessment and testing; Redwood is prohibited from using Assessment Data for model training, fine-tuning, or benchmarking beyond the explicit joint evaluation for the deal.
- Logging/audit: require access logs accessible to Arcadia on request during the retention period.
- Deletion certificate: Redwood to provide a deletion certificate within 10 business days of confirmed deletion.

Marcus — can you validate that the runtime team can provide the access log export and deletion certificate? If yes, we'll accept the 90-day retention as long as the training prohibition is strict.

—
Vivek
Head of Product Ops, Redwood Inference

[Forwarded attachment: Arcadia_DAA_standard.docx]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Robinson <maya@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, procurement@arcadiahealth.com
Date: Tue, Sep 16, 2025 at 11:06 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Arcadia: Assessment corpus exchange & MAP — next steps

Hi Maya —

Thanks for the quick review and the DAA. Quick updates from our side after internal alignment:

- We accepted the 90-day retention window. We'll add a clause for deletion certificate within 10 business days after deletion.
- We will add a strict "no training" clause for any Assessment Data (explicit in section 2.1).
- We can provide an access-log export for evaluation sessions; Marcus confirmed format and cadence below.

I uploaded an updated MAP and a DocuSign envelope for signature here:
- MAP draft: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cArcadiaEvalPack
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Signing/?acct=XXX&envelopeId=AAABBB

Technical handoff notes for your engineers:
- Full dataset will be delivered via a time-limited SFTP link (credentials rotated per exchange).
- Prompt pack includes canonical prompts, expected response format, and evaluation harness (unit tests).
- We will seed the evaluation harness with 500 test cases; you will get the remaining cases after the MAP is signed.

Please confirm: who should I address the DocuSign envelope to on your legal/procurement side? Once signed we will upload the full dataset and generate the access-log token for your team.

If it helps, I'm free for a 15m legal sync tomorrow at 9:30am PT.

—
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Arcadia_MAP_v1_updated.docx (24 KB)]

Subject: Re: Arcadia: Assessment corpus exchange & MAP — next steps

Jasmine / team —

Confirmed: procurement signed (envelope returned) and legal accepted the redlines you added. Attached is the signed MAP (Arcadia_Signed_MAP.pdf) and we provisioned the seed dataset to the shared Drive folder you provided. Our engineers completed a quick verification of the sample; we added the data_source_id column as requested and one of the testcases had a formatting mismatch (fixed locally).

Next steps on our side:
1) Arcadia will run the seeded evaluation harness this week and share results by Sep 25.
2) If everything looks good, we will request the full dataset via the SFTP link and confirm access.
3) Procurement will follow up on invoicing terms separately.

Thanks for the clear guardrails — appreciate the deletion certificate and the access-log cadence. Looking forward to the readout.

—
Liam Chen
